hero_home.title: The Anointing Oil Collection
hero_home.line: Biblical botanicals in a base of olive squalane. Blended by hand in Texas.

hero_shop.title: Every oil, one olive base
hero_shop.line: Frankincense & Myrrh, Hyssop, Spikenard, Latter Rain, Rose of Sharon, Lily of the Valley, Pomegranate, Gethsemane, Frankincense, Myrrh, and 100% Olive Squalane.

oils.name: Frankincense & Myrrh
oils.line: Two gifts of the Magi, for prayer, worship, and blessing.

oils.name: Hyssop
oils.line: The herb of purification. Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean.

oils.name: Spikenard
oils.line: The precious oil Mary poured out at Bethany in extravagant worship.

oils.name: Latter Rain
oils.line: The rain before the harvest, a picture of renewal and the outpouring of the Spirit.

oils.name: Rose of Sharon
oils.line: I am the rose of Sharon. The flower of the Song of Solomon.

oils.name: Lily of the Valley
oils.line: A symbol of purity and peace, the lily of the valleys.

oils.name: Pomegranate
oils.line: A symbol of fruitfulness and abundance, one of the seven blessed fruits.

oils.name: Gethsemane
oils.line: Pure olive squalane, in the simplicity of the garden where Jesus prayed.

oils.name: Frankincense
oils.line: A symbol of prayer rising before God like incense.

oils.name: Myrrh
oils.line: A symbol of purification and of Christ's sacrifice.

oils.name: 100% Olive Squalane
oils.line: The base of every oil we make, from the olive, pure oil for the light.

scripture.quote: Thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.

story.title: Rooted in Scripture. Blended in Texas.
story.line: Every oil begins with the plants Scripture names, carried in olive squalane.

inside.title: Biblical botanicals in olive squalane
inside.line: Frankincense, myrrh, spikenard, hyssop, pomegranate, rose of Sharon, and lily of the valley. Naturally derived. Cruelty-free. No parabens, phthalates, sulfates, or synthetic fragrance.
